prior_research: Both European evaluation seasons and known Bet365 versus consensus 1X2 totals were previously examined. Replays are historical research.

consensus_forward_recipe.books: complete 1X2 price triples of distinct provider bookmaker keys; latest observed regional event raw file collected no later than current study cutoff, source quotes aged at most 60 min; exclude exchange price and lay markets; one triple per brand, at least 3 incl the original Pinnacle reference
consensus_forward_recipe.horizon: registered fixtures and first available real issue before kick-off
consensus_forward_recipe.baseline: original frozen market baseline, retargeted to fresh Pinnacle 1X2 and observed Pinnacle totals offer, including Asian full-win/loss conditional on non-void fractions
consensus_forward_recipe.candidate: same baseline and actual fixed Pinnacle totals, project WDL to consensus; both alternatives use identical peers and sample
consensus_forward_recipe.summary: WDL IQR across books in percentage points and coverage. Three-arm comparison; all official first issues retained.

metrics: strict total full win excluding pushes
uncertainty: Matchday-block intervals for historical cohorts, retain actual Asian settlements.
sample_handling: Source-timed over/under paired prices and identities for prospective input, regulation-only final for settlement, no retrospective replacement.
nations_reference: Independent national-team Elo estimated or observed strictly before fixture; compare at the same date to retained references where available, separate forward status.
collection: Registered Brazil six first; keep original quotes and source times, per market bookmaker and team; record unsupported or missing markets separately.
